Cloudflare apply plan for officers.example.org

  WARNING: officers.example.org is already published (tunnel route or DNS record exists) but no Access application protects it. Setup changes nothing that publishes the hostname, and creates its Access application at step 5; the hostname stays unprotected until that step reads back ok. Do not start cloudflared until this run reports done.

   1. add the One-time PIN identity provider
   2. create Access group Officers
   3. create Access group Launchpad
   4. create service token officer-dashboard services
   5. create Access application Officer Dashboard with policy Officers and Launchpad
   6. create Access application Officer Dashboard: agents (bypass) with policy Everyone (bypass)
   7. create Access application Officer Dashboard: services (service token) with policy Service token
   8. add rule "Agents and services: skip bot checks" to http_request_firewall_custom (create the phase's ruleset with it)
   9. add rule "Agents and services: bypass cache" to http_request_cache_settings (create the phase's ruleset with it)
  10. add rule "Consent page: no rewriting" to http_config_settings (create the phase's ruleset with it)
  11. fetch the token of tunnel 6ff42ae2-765d-4adf-8112-31c55c1551ef (the host has none)
  manual: Bot Fight Mode is on for the whole zone. Setup leaves it, because it also affects the zone's other hostnames. In the Cloudflare dashboard, open the domain → Security → Settings → filter Bot traffic → Bot Fight Mode → Off (docs/deploy/cloudflare.md step 6.1)
  manual: Global session duration 730h (1 month) (not set (Cloudflare's default is 24h). Setup does not write the Zero Trust organization unless allowed. In Zero Trust: Access controls → Access settings → Set your global session duration → Edit → 1 month → Save (docs/deploy/cloudflare.md step 3))
